query:
UPDATE
                email_scheduled_messages
            SET
                processing = false,
                delivery_claim_id = NULL,
                delivery_lease_expires_at = NULL,
                delivery_started_at = NULL,
                delivery_status = 'ready',
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE
                message_id = $1
                AND link_id = $2
                AND NOT sent
                AND processing
                AND delivery_status = 'ready'
                AND delivery_started_at IS NULL
